content_of_post_to_comment:
I wake up with good intentions, but most days I end up doing almost nothing productive. I constantly deal with brain fog, low motivation, poor focus, and procrastination. Even when I know exactly what I should be doing, I struggle to start or stay consistent.

I don't want to keep living like this anymore.

My goal is to build a better future for myself. I want to learn a valuable skill, start earning money as early as I can, and eventually build a successful career. But right now, I feel completely stuck, and it seems like I'm wasting my time instead of moving toward my goals.

I'm making this post because I want advice from people who have been in a similar situation and managed to turn their lives around.

How did you get out of this cycle?

How did you improve your focus and discipline?

What skill would you recommend learning if my goal is to start earning online in the future?

What daily habits made the biggest difference for you?

I'm not looking for quick motivation. I'm looking for practical advice from people who have actually gone through this and found a way out.

Thank you to anyone who takes the time to reply.
comment: The hardest part is usually not learning a skill, it's rebuilding trust with yourself after months of not following through. I found that setting tiny daily targets worked better than waiting for motivation. One hour of focused practice every day on a useful skill compounds faster than occasional bursts of effort. Also, don't ignore sleep, exercise, and your environment — brain fog is often made worse by the basics being off.
